findings.highlight: in a worse coma than before
findings.evidenceJa: 今までより重い衰弱状態
findings.governingReading: a more severe state of debilitation than previous victims
findings.explanation: The victims’ worsened physical depletion is recast as a deeper or worse coma.

findings.highlight: WhaCaster hasn’t disappeared?
findings.evidenceJa: なキャスターが、消えてない？
findings.governingReading: Wha—Caster has not disappeared?
findings.explanation: A missing boundary fuses Shirou’s interrupted exclamation to Caster’s name.

findings.highlight: I don’t think you made a misunderstanding.
findings.evidenceJa: 勘違いしてるとも思えない
findings.governingReading: Rin does not believe Shirou is mistaken
findings.explanation: A basic collocation is rendered as “made a misunderstanding.”

findings.highlight: the scene of the crime yesterday
findings.evidenceJa: 昨日の夜、被害のあった現場
findings.governingReading: the site of the harm last night
findings.explanation: The nighttime anchor disappears and an evidentiary “crime scene” classification is added.

findings.highlight: different from yesterday
findings.evidenceJa: 昨日までの遠坂
findings.governingReading: Rin as she had been through yesterday
findings.explanation: A comparison against Rin’s prior state through the preceding day is narrowed to one day.

findings.highlight: forfeit from the Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争を降りる
findings.governingReading: withdraw from the Holy Grail War
findings.explanation: The recurring game-like “forfeit from” phrasing is both unnatural and tonally wrong.

findings.highlight: there’s something different going on where we can’t see it
findings.evidenceJa: わたしたちの知らないところで違う事が行われてる
findings.governingReading: some different process or act is being carried out beyond their knowledge
findings.explanation: The passive sense of unknown agency and deliberate activity is weakened to something merely happening out of sight.

findings.highlight: it must be true
findings.evidenceJa: 間違いはないんだろう
findings.governingReading: she is probably not mistaken
findings.explanation: Shirou’s trust-bearing but qualified inference is strengthened into certainty.

findings.highlight: I don’t like not knowing the harm I may be imposing on others.
findings.evidenceJa: 利用された自分が、誰にどんな危害をくわえるのか判らない
findings.governingReading: Rin objects to not knowing whom the used version of herself will harm, or what kind of harm she will inflict
findings.explanation: The unknown target, nature of harm, and loss of self-directed agency are generalized.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka’s eyes show her determination
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の目には迷いがなく
findings.governingReading: there is no hesitation in Rin’s eyes
findings.explanation: Absence of doubt is converted into a more generic positive trait.

findings.highlight: it seems to be asking for my stance
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の選択を問うているように見えた
findings.governingReading: her eyes simultaneously seem to ask what Shirou will choose
findings.explanation: The singular pronoun has no stable antecedent and “stance” weakens an actual choice.

findings.highlight: I want to cooperate with Tohsaka.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は遠坂と、こんなふうな協力関係でありたかった
findings.governingReading: until that time comes, Shirou wants to remain in this kind of cooperative relationship with Rin
findings.explanation: The duration, continuing relationship, and deictic “like this” are reduced to generic cooperation.

findings.highlight: I try to suppress my face from turning red
findings.evidenceJa: 急速に赤くなりつつある頬を堪えて
findings.governingReading: enduring or trying to contain his rapidly reddening cheeks
findings.explanation: The English uses an unnatural construction in which Shirou suppresses his face.

findings.highlight: Please give me your best regards too
findings.evidenceJa: 少しの間だろうけど
findings.governingReading: although it will probably be only for a short while
findings.explanation: Rin’s explicit limit on the provisional alliance disappears.

findings.highlight: Her hand is soft, much more delicate than mine.
findings.evidenceJa: かすかに冷たかった
findings.governingReading: her hand is faintly cold as well as soft and delicate
findings.explanation: A final tactile detail in Shirou’s reaction disappears.

findings.highlight: WHAT THE HELL AM I THINKING
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の節操なし
findings.governingReading: Shirou condemns himself as shameless or lacking restraint
findings.explanation: The moral-sexual edge of his self-rebuke disappears.

findings.highlight: I quickly let go of Tohsaka’s hand
findings.evidenceJa: 強引に手を離す
findings.governingReading: he forcibly tears or pulls his hand free
findings.explanation: Force is changed into speed, weakening the physical comedy of his panic.

findings.highlight: when we last met
findings.evidenceJa: この前相談された時
findings.governingReading: when Rin was consulted by Shirou previously
findings.explanation: A specific earlier consultation becomes their most recent meeting in general.

findings.highlight: stares at me from head to toe
findings.evidenceJa: じろじろ、にやにやと人を上から下まで値踏みする
findings.governingReading: Rin openly looks him up and down, grinning as she appraises him
findings.explanation: The grin and evaluative inspection that drive the teasing disappear.

findings.highlight: Manhow can such an evil smile
findings.evidenceJa: ああこんな邪な笑顔が
findings.governingReading: Man, how can such a wicked smile
findings.explanation: A missing boundary visibly fuses “Man” and “how.”

findings.highlight: I think I’ll suffer more damage
findings.evidenceJa: 二倍や三倍じゃすまない
findings.governingReading: the shock would not stop at merely two or three times the usual force
findings.explanation: The comic numerical escalation of Rin’s personal impact disappears.

findings.highlight: You’re the type that masturbates to the girl you like, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 好きな子のリコーダーが気になるタイプ
findings.governingReading: the type who becomes preoccupied with the school recorder belonging to a girl he likes
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces the school-crush recorder joke with an explicit unsupported masturbation accusation.

findings.highlight: gets hot and bothered over the recorder of the girl you like
findings.evidenceJa: 好きな子のリコーダーが気になるタイプ
findings.governingReading: the type who is curious about or preoccupied with the recorder of a girl he likes
findings.explanation: Even the classic branch makes the insinuation explicitly sexual rather than preserving the teasingly ambiguous interest in a school instrument.

findings.highlight: an expression of victory
findings.evidenceJa: ふふん、なんて勝利者の笑み
findings.governingReading: a victor’s smile accompanied by a smug “fufun”
findings.explanation: Rin’s smug audible delivery disappears.
